description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule diff behavior, particularly when submodules are not initialized or have been removed. It contains test setup routines, submodule operations, and assertions to verify correct handling of submodule states.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a specified directory in a Git repository, commits the changes, and returns the short hash of the latest commit.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message indicating the files being committed.
